frozen_before: any kNN or hybrid result was inspected (RR-06 item 7); analyzer results were also not inspected before freezing
evaluation_population: the `reviews` alias: every deduplicated, validated silver review with non-empty text (693,547 documents at silver snapshot 8507728480475534879)
relevance: binary per query rule below; internal states relevant | not_relevant | cannot_judge; unjudged is a pooling state and is never scored as not_relevant
primary_metric: macro-average P@5 per stratum and overall
pooling: top-10 of every evaluated system, deduplicated, presented in a seeded random order with the retriever hidden; later phases pool their own new top-10 documents and every system is recomputed on the complete judgements

hypotheses.search_analyzer: H-A1: bm25_stemmed >= bm25_plain on macro P@5 for the descriptive stratum. H-A2: the two analyzers differ by at most 0.1 macro P@5 on the lexical stratum. Reported as held / not held; neither is a pass line. The higher overall macro P@5 becomes the frozen BM25 default (tie -> bm25_plain, the unstemmed baseline).
hypotheses.embeddings: H-E1: BM25 >= kNN on lexical. H-E2: kNN >= BM25 on descriptive. H-E3: hybrid >= BM25 overall. (RR-06; evaluated in P5, frozen here.)

queries.information_need: Reviews of the Philips Norelco T980 vacuum trimmer specifically.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the review is about a Philips Norelco T980 (the trimmer model), whether named in the text or evident from the product title.

queries.information_need: Reviews of the Salux nylon Japanese bath wash cloth.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the review is about a Salux-brand bath cloth or towel.

queries.information_need: Reviews of Godefroy tint kits for brows or beards.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the review is about a Godefroy tint or colouring kit.

queries.information_need: Reviews of TIGI Bed Head hairspray products.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the review is about a Bed Head (TIGI) hairspray; other Bed Head products are not relevant.

queries.information_need: Reviews of hair brushes with boar bristles.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewed product is a boar-bristle hair brush (title or text).

queries.information_need: Reviews of facial serums whose named ingredient is hyaluronic acid.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewed product is a serum and hyaluronic acid is named as an ingredient in the title or text.

queries.information_need: Reviews of tea tree oil shampoos.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewed product is a shampoo containing tea tree (title or text).

queries.information_need: Reviews of argan oil shampoos.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewed product is a shampoo with argan oil (title or text); argan oil on its own is not relevant.

queries.information_need: Reviews of sunscreens rated SPF 50.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewed product is a sunscreen or sun-protective product and SPF 50 is stated.

queries.information_need: Reviews of Mitchell's Wool Fat shaving soap.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the review is about Mitchell's Wool Fat shaving soap (refill or bowl).

queries.query: shampoo that made my hair fall out
queries.information_need: Complaints that a hair product caused hair loss or shedding.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports hair loss, thinning or shedding attributed to the reviewed product.

queries.query: razor irritates my skin and gives me bumps
queries.information_need: Complaints that a shaving product causes irritation, razor burn or bumps.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports skin irritation, razor burn, bumps or ingrown hairs from a shaving product.

queries.query: nail polish chips after one day
queries.information_need: Complaints that a nail product chips or peels quickly.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports nail polish or gel chipping, peeling or wearing off within a few days.

queries.query: arrived leaking and the bottle was half empty
queries.information_need: Complaints about a product arriving damaged, leaking or under-filled.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports the item arrived leaked, broken, opened, or with missing quantity.

queries.query: curling iron does not get hot enough to hold a curl
queries.information_need: Complaints that a heated styling tool underperforms on heat or hold.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports a curling iron, wand or straightener not heating enough or curls not holding.

queries.information_need: Complaints that brushes lose bristles.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports a makeup or hair brush shedding or losing bristles.

queries.query: smells like chemicals and gave me a headache
queries.information_need: Complaints about an unpleasant or overpowering scent causing discomfort.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports a chemical, strong or unpleasant smell from the product, with or without a headache.

queries.query: trimmer battery stopped holding a charge after a few months
queries.information_need: Complaints that a rechargeable grooming device's battery degraded or died.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports a battery that no longer charges or holds charge on a grooming or beauty device.

queries.query: I think this is fake not the real product
queries.information_need: Suspicions of counterfeit or not-as-described products.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer states or suspects the product is counterfeit, fake, or different from the genuine item.

queries.query: finally something that helped my dry cracked heels
queries.information_need: Positive reports of a foot-care product improving dry or cracked heels.
queries.relevance_rule: Relevant iff the reviewer reports improvement of dry, rough or cracked feet or heels from the product.
